'''Pickled carrots''' are the preservation of the [[carrot]]. They heal {{Hp|4}} and grant {{EffectLink|Night Vision}} for 5 minutes.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/pickled_carrots.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A raw carrot, a brown [[mushroom]] and a glass bottle. Picking up a carrot unlocks the recipe.
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating pickled carrots takes 1.6 seconds, heals {{Hp|4}} and gives Night Vision for 5:00. It gives the glass bottle back when eaten.
